row.notes: myteam-g2: Gets enabled upgrades (Career_Query_EnabledUpgrades), keeps those whose latest state (<= day mask) is 3 (installed) and drops type +0x72 == 2, then sums per department: (department stat range max-min from team+0x1a38) / (sum of upgrade weights in the department) * upgrade weight (+0x64), returned as the total gain. Read-only; the performance number shown in R&D / department UI.
